name: Bench: Command: Undead (504908) credits the necromancer for a minion kill without a swing
contract: SoloKill.RequirePlayerHit (#10365, default 1) gives an ungrouped player experience from a creature only if they 'hit' it themselves (Creature::AddDirectPlayerAttacker, Spell.cpp:3130 / Unit.cpp:1317). Command: Undead 504908 is one of the generic Commands (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp Responds(), alongside 500991/504868/504908/805871) that answer any non-Stationary minion. A level-60 necromancer raises one Greater Skeletal Warrior (51065, via Raise: Greater Skeletal Warrior 504901) and never swings; Command: Undead on a weak creature lets the warrior kill it alone. This bench proves on unfixed main whether that commanded kill gives the necromancer experience (intended behaviour, 'option A': every Command order counts as the player's hit). 504908 has a single effect using TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ALLY (Spell.dbc EffectImplicitTargetA[0]=31), unlike 504907/504868 whose second effect targets TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY (6) directly; casting it at an explicit hostile target makes Spell::prepare set the destination to that target (Spell.cpp:787) 25y from the caster and its own minion, so the ally-area search may miss the minion. This scenario instead selects the creature (so Order() can fall back to the selected target) and self-casts 504908 so its destination defaults to the caster (Spell.cpp:792), covering the minion standing next to it.

steps.label: SETUP: the Greater Skeletal Warrior exists
Command: Undead (504908), self-cast so its area-ally effect centers on the caster, with the creature selected
BENCH: the commanded kill gives experience
BENCH: the necromancer's level is unchanged
